title: Normalized coefficient extension and quotient-model data
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, finite extensions $E\subset L$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], and a scheme $W$. Use whole coefficient systems [def-coef-ringed-sequence-site], their coherent reduction calculi [def-coef-derived-system-calculus-data], and completed scalar extension [def-weil-integral-scalar-extension]. Define CoefficientExtensionSystems as the semilinear scalar systems [def-coef-semilinear-derived-calculus] for the actual constant quotient-ring maps $B^E_n\to B^L_n$. Its coefficientExtensionSystem is derived scalar change of the coherent $E$ reduction. A coefficient-extension reduction datum consists of balanced ordinary and derived scalar associations, direct quotient complexes on every flat-term K-flat representative, finite evaluation isomorphisms, the actual quotient-transition equations, a derived comparison normalized by those evaluations, normalization of the resulting systems, and a completion isomorphism fixed by its Roos projections, whose actual coherent counit comparison is invertible. Balanced association sends $(x\otimes a)\otimes b$ to $x\otimes\iota(a)b$. The associated identity and successive scalar comparison data carry their ordinary section formula and K-flat derived-counit equation. All representative notions use [def-pc-kflat-complex], [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules] and [def-pur-coefficient-reduction-presentation]. These are data types and predicates only, without an existence assertion or flatness assumption on quotient-ring maps.
